instruction: Identify and visit the Virginia driver's license fee listing page.

metadata.explanation: Task variation navigates to the driver's license fees page on Virginia DMV website. Uses the same existing evaluator functions (is_expected_active_tab with active_url_from_accessTree getter) to verify the correct target URL is reached. No custom functions needed as we reuse the existing Chrome URL checking infrastructure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: navigating to Virginia DMV driver's license fees page
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar element
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the actual URL against the expected URL using compare_urls() function
Expected URL (https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/license/applying/fees) is semantically correct for the instruction
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (navigate to specific page) and evaluator checks this requirement
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree -> extract URL with prefix -> compare with expected URL -> return 1.0 or 0.0
The goto_prefix configuration ('https://www.') correctly matches the expected URL format
